status_summary: HUD has reviewed and withdrawn guidance under Executive Orders 14192 and 14219. An Office of Fair Housing and Equal Opportunity memo of 2025-09-17 withdrew nine documents, formalized in a notice published 2026-04-06 (91 FR 17291, eight documents, effective 2025-09-17), and an Office of General Counsel notice published 2026-07-17 (91 FR 44867) withdrew 13 documents effective 2025-09-25, covering topics such as criminal records screening, source of income, limited English proficiency, special purpose credit and appraisal elements of proof. HUD said it withdrew guidance that was not statutorily prescribed, was inconsistent with the governing statute or regulation, or did not reduce compliance burdens. The HUD Secretary said on 2025-02-28 that the department was taking inventory of burdensome regulations.

timeline.event: The HUD Secretary said at a builders' conference that HUD was taking inventory of and terminating burdensome regulations.
An HUD fair housing office memo withdrew nine fair housing guidance documents.
HUD published a notice (91 FR 17291) withdrawing eight fair housing guidance documents, effective 2025-09-17.
HUD published a notice (91 FR 44867) withdrawing 13 Office of General Counsel guidance documents under Executive Orders 14192 and 14219, effective 2025-09-25.

title: Review and withdraw HUD subregulatory guidance issued outside notice and comment
